title: Transfer Certificate
description: Admission, leaving and reviewed clearance details.
body: This is to certify that {{name}}, admission number {{admissionNumber}}, studied at {{schoolName}} in {{class}} from {{startDate}} to {{endDate}}. The recorded reason for leaving is {{leavingReason}}. Conduct during this period was recorded as {{conduct}}. Fee clearance, as reviewed by the school office: {{feeClearance}}.

title: Bonafide Certificate
description: Confirms current enrolment at the school.
body: This is to certify that {{name}}, admission number {{admissionNumber}}, is a bonafide student of {{schoolName}}, studying in {{class}} during academic year {{academicYear}}. This certificate is issued for {{purpose}}.

title: Character Certificate
body: This is to certify that {{name}}, a student of {{schoolName}} in {{class}}, has the following character assessment recorded by the school: {{conduct}}. This certificate is issued for {{purpose}}.

title: Study Certificate
body: This is to certify that {{name}}, admission number {{admissionNumber}}, studied at {{schoolName}} from {{startDate}} to {{endDate}}. The class recorded for this certificate is {{class}}. This certificate is issued for {{purpose}}.

title: Date of Birth Certificate
description: Confirms the date of birth in the student record.
body: This is to certify that the date of birth of {{name}}, admission number {{admissionNumber}}, is recorded in the school admission register as {{dob}}. This certificate confirms the school record and is issued for {{purpose}}.

title: Conduct Certificate
description: Confirms conduct during the period of study.
body: This is to certify that {{name}}, a student of {{schoolName}} in {{class}}, has the following conduct recorded by the school: {{conduct}}. This certificate is issued for {{purpose}}.

title: Employment Certificate
body: This is to certify that {{name}}, employee number {{employeeId}}, is employed at {{schoolName}} as {{designation}} in {{department}}, with service commencing on {{startDate}}. This certificate is issued for {{purpose}}.

title: Experience Certificate
description: Records the employee's period of service.
body: This is to certify that {{name}}, employee number {{employeeId}}, served at {{schoolName}} as {{designation}} in {{department}} from {{startDate}} to {{endDate}}. This certificate is issued for {{purpose}}.

title: Salary Certificate
description: Confidential confirmation of a reviewed salary amount.
body: This is to certify that {{name}}, employee number {{employeeId}}, is employed at {{schoolName}} as {{designation}}. The salary amount reviewed and confirmed by the school office is {{salaryAmount}}, for {{salaryPeriod}}. This certificate is issued for {{purpose}}.

title: Service Certificate
description: Confirms a defined period of service.
body: This is to certify that {{name}}, employee number {{employeeId}}, rendered service to {{schoolName}} as {{designation}} in {{department}} from {{startDate}} to {{endDate}}. This certificate is issued for {{purpose}}.

title: Appreciation Certificate
body: {{schoolName}} records its appreciation of {{name}}, {{designation}}, for the following contribution: {{achievement}}. We acknowledge this contribution with gratitude.

title: Relieving Certificate
description: Confirms the last working date and reviewed clearance.
body: This is to certify that {{name}}, employee number {{employeeId}}, served at {{schoolName}} as {{designation}} from {{startDate}} to {{endDate}} and was relieved of duties on {{endDate}}. The office has recorded the following clearance position: {{feeClearance}}. This certificate is issued for {{purpose}}.

title: Annual Fee Certificate
description: Preserves existing annual fee certificate requests.
body: This is to certify that the school office has reviewed the fee records for {{name}}, admission number {{admissionNumber}}, for academic year {{academicYear}}. The recorded position is: {{feeClearance}}. This certificate is issued for {{purpose}}.

title: Other Certificate
body: {{schoolName}} certifies the following in respect of {{name}}, admission number {{admissionNumber}}: {{achievement}}. This certificate is issued for {{purpose}}.
